grade.name: LKG
grade.description: Lower Kindergarten curriculum for ages 4-5. English teaches reading through phonics vowel families (Short A, E, I, O, U) with structured blending, reading, spelling, and fluency progression. Maths accelerates to numbers 1-130 with addition. Hindi teaches reading through systematic matra progression (bina matra through anuswar). Includes multi-bin classification, logic puzzles, safety and citizenship themes, and habitat/lifecycle-level EVS content.
